limitations: Fixed composition, two colors, uniform circular words; no claim for arbitrary nonuniform or dependent binary sequences.
Cross-color association is restricted to increasing functionals of cumulative short-run profiles.
Prior joint run-statistic distribution formulas may imply moment identities after specialization; the all-threshold stochastic association property requires a separate comparison.
scientific_integrity: Finite enumeration provides checks, not infinite-size proof. A self-contained refinement-coupling proof handles every fixed composition. The result is not independently reviewed.
title: Opposite-color short-run profiles are positively associated in fixed-content random circles
